sections.name: classifyReactorSubIndustry
sections.title: Maps reactor codes to sub-industry names
sections.what: Takes a reactor family code such as PWR or BWR, plus its electric size, and returns a named reactor category. For light-water reactors the size decides between the small and large category, and unknown codes return nothing.
sections.why: The comment says it is the single source of truth, mirroring the PRIS backfill, so the app and the data fill-in give the same answer.
sections.watch_out: Returned names must match the list in the shared industries file exactly, and nothing here reports a mismatch.

summary: Maps a reactor family code and its electric size to one named nuclear reactor category, or to nothing when the code is not recognized.
purpose: Gives the app one agreed answer for how a reactor type is grouped, so screens and the data fill-in process do not disagree.
why: The file comment says it is the single source of truth and mirrors a data backfill exactly. Only light-water reactors are split by size, as the comment explains.
how: First the input is cleaned: blank input returns nothing, otherwise the text is trimmed and made uppercase. The light-water types PWR and BWR are split by size: above zero and under 300 electric megawatts is the small category, otherwise the large category, and a missing size counts as large. Other codes map straight to a named category. Any text containing the letters for research or test becomes the research category. Anything else returns nothing.
inputs: A reactor type text code, which may be empty, and an optional electric capacity in megawatts electric.
outputs: One category name from a fixed list, or nothing (null) when the code is missing or unknown.
risks: Category names must match the shared industries list exactly, and nothing here checks that. Unknown codes return nothing with no message. The research or test check matches any text containing those letters, not only whole words.
debug: If a reactor shows no category, check the spelling of its code and whether the code appears in the switch list. If a large reactor shows as small, check its size value. Compare category names with the shared industries file named in the comment.
